title: feat(plugin-chatbot,app-shell): Preview for any copilot draft kind, its deep-link table, the console wiring and the preview bar's pending line (objectui#12968)
body:
Fixes #12968
Clause-②: yes — `ChatbotEnhancedProps` gains the optional `onPreviewDraft`, so `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot` is at `minor`.

objectstack-ai/objectstack#24324 ruling A (preview-first). This pull request lands the half of the card that lives inside the claimed file surface. The console wiring of the new Preview callback lives in `packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/AiChatPage.tsx` (the `ChatPane` that renders `ChatbotEnhanced` for the console, the Studio copilot and the chat dock) and in `LiveCanvas.tsx`, which is not in the claim. So the card stays open, and merging this pull request must not close it.

## What changes

- **`@object-ui/plugin-chatbot`.** A drafted tool result whose items include no `app` now draws **Preview** beside Publish and Review. It draws when the host passes the new optional `onPreviewDraft(items, { appSegment })` and the result names its owning `packageId`. The click hands the host the drafted `{ type, name }` items and the package id, which is the app's route segment (ADR-0048). A draft set that includes an app keeps `onPreviewDraftApp`, unchanged. A host that passes no `onPreviewDraft` draws exactly what it drew before. Preview publishes nothing.
- **`@object-ui/app-shell`, `preview/draftSurface.ts`.** This file maps a draft to the surface that shows it, in both directions.
  - `draftPreviewPath(items, appSegment)` is the deep-link table, always under `?preview=draft`: a page → that page; a view → the object's list on that view; a field or object → the object's default list; an app, or a kind with no surface of its own → the app (the URL the Live Canvas already opens). A batch previews its most specific surface. Paths come from `@object-ui/layout`'s `resolveHref`, the console's one nav-to-URL mapping. No second URL scheme is spelled.
  - `draftSurfaceOf` and `draftsOnSurface` map the route the preview shows back to the pending drafts that belong to it. They match the route against `APP_ROUTE_METADATA_READS`, the table of every route `AppContent` declares.
- **`DraftPreviewBar`.** When the surface it shows has pending drafts of its own, the message names them on one line, from the entries `usePendingDrafts` already reads: 「草稿预览 · 本页 2 项未发布」 / "Draft preview · 2 unpublished changes on this page". Everything else in the bar is unchanged: the package-wide count stays on Changes, and Exit and Publish are untouched. No new request is made.
- **`@object-ui/i18n`.** `preview.draftBar.pendingHere` is a plural family in all ten packs, with each pack's CLDR categories, following `preview.changes.summaryItems`.

## Measurements (the dispatch's mechanism assumptions)

- **A1 (before the change), held.** On the unmodified tree (`43efd078aa`), `ChatbotEnhanced.draftPreviewAny-12968.test.tsx` rendered an `add_field` drafted result (`type: 'object'`, `changedKeys: ['fields']`, `packageId: 'app.crm'`) with the console's `onPreviewDraftApp` wired. It drew no Preview: `Unable to find an element by: [data-testid="draft-preview"]`, 4 failed and 3 passed. The `draft-preview-app` control also found no element. View and page drafts were the same.
- **A2, partly held.** A drafted result carries `{ type, name }` items and `packageId` (`detectDraftResult`). `changedKeys` is not lifted, and no record id is carried.
  - The object of a view or field draft comes from its qualified name: the spec's `ViewItemNameSchema` says the object "can be recovered from the prefix", and a field row is keyed by the object and field name. No new request is needed.
  - A field added to an existing object is drafted as the object itself.
  - **Not derivable: the record row** ("the record page when the draft names a record"). No drafted envelope this chat lifts names a record, so that row is not implemented. See the open questions in the report.
- **A3, held, with a rule chosen.** The bar sits above the app's nested routes. It reads the splat of `/apps/:appName/*` (`useParams()['*']`) and matches it against `APP_ROUTE_METADATA_READS`. The rule: an object route (its list, a view, a record) counts the drafts of type `object` with that name, plus the `view` and `field` drafts under that object. A page, dashboard or report route counts the draft of that name. A route with no single surface (the app landing, metadata admin, search) shows today's message.
- **A3, the field-draft sentence: not derivable.** `_drafts` rows (`ListDraftsResponseSchema`) carry `type`, `name`, `member`, `label`, `packageId`, `updatedAt` and `updatedBy`. They carry no `changedKeys`, and a field draft is an `object` draft. So "this pending draft adds a field" cannot be read from the count `usePendingDrafts` already reads. The sentence is not shipped. See the open questions in the report.

## Tests

The run is at `f9a8e54cb0`, with vitest `--maxWorkers=1`, under the shared lock.

- New: `packages/plugin-chatbot/src/__tests__/ChatbotEnhanced.draftPreviewAny-12968.test.tsx` (7 tests). It covers field, view and page drafts → Preview with items and segment; the app row unchanged; CONTROL with no `onPreviewDraft`; CONTROL with no package; and that Preview makes no publish call or request.
- New: `packages/app-shell/src/preview/__tests__/draftPreview-12968.test.tsx` (18 tests). It covers the deep-link table, one row per kind with the app row unchanged; the surface filter; the bar's line on an object list and on a page; CONTROL on a surface with nothing pending, on the app landing, and outside preview (nothing drawn, nothing read).
- Families that name the Preview button, `DraftPreviewBar`, `usePendingDrafts`, `PreviewModeContext` or `?preview=draft`, plus the locale-content i18n tests: 43 files / 350 tests passed, and 35 files / 363 tests passed. The existing `DraftPreviewBar.test.tsx` and `ChatbotEnhanced.test.tsx` are unchanged and green.
- **Ablation, once.** `ablation-replace` mutated `return onPreviewDraft && appSegment ? (` to `return false && onPreviewDraft && appSegment ? (`, which restores the app-only condition. The anchor went from 1 to 0 hits and the blob from `2e650291b551` to `65a99e6ea4b5`. The new chatbot pin went red with 4 failed and 3 passed. The restore was proved by blob hash: the blob after restore equals the HEAD blob `2e650291b551`, and `git diff HEAD` was empty.
- Declared to CI: the full test directories of `packages/plugin-chatbot`, `packages/app-shell` and `packages/i18n`.

- Closure build `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/app-shell^...'` reported 28 of 28 tasks successful.
- `type-check`: `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot` exit 0 and `@object-ui/i18n` exit 0. `@object-ui/app-shell`: the result is in the dev report (the shared lock queue).
- Lint, narrowed to the 15 changed files (`eslint --no-inline-config --format json`): 15 files, 0 errors. All 11 warnings are on `ChatbotEnhanced.tsx` lines this diff does not touch. The config enables no type-aware linting, so the diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file.
- Each of these exited 0: `check:phantom-deps`, `check:self-import`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:doc-example-readers`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:side-effects-array`, `check:element-data-source-declaration`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:action-forward-parity`, `check:designer-field-key-parity`, `check:icon-record-names`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-designer-parity`, `check:control-bytes`, `check-hand-rolled-comment-mask.mjs`, `check-changeset-fixed.mjs`, `check-changeset-presence.mjs` and `check:new-line-citations`.

## Not in this pull request (named, so the card keeps them)

1. **Console wiring.** `ChatPane` must pass `onPreviewDraft` and open `draftPreviewPath(items, appSegment)`. For example, the Live Canvas needs to accept a path beside the app segment, or the handler navigates. The files are `AiChatPage.tsx` (objectui#12965's claimed surface) and `LiveCanvas.tsx`, both outside this claim. Until then the console still draws Preview only for app drafts.
2. **The 确认修改 applied card.** Copilot edits that pass the confirm gate land on the applied-card path (`replayOutcome` drafted). That path lifts no drafted items (`detectReplayOutcome` in `mapMessages.ts`, outside the claim), so it draws no Preview yet.
3. **The field-draft sentence on the bar, and the record row.** These need a decision (see above).

## Acceptance notes

- Nothing publishes and no publish path is added. `/data` is not read. `AiChatPage.tsx` is untouched. The published-only and member-view tests are unchanged.
- `draftSurface.ts` is not exported from the `@object-ui/app-shell` barrel, so the package's public face does not grow.
- [x] Adds no product-specific widget, dialog, hook or string (see AGENTS.md › Product-neutral renderer)

The session is `https://claude.ai/code/session_01XVp19E1MYUTFM3dnkwz8gB`.


## Patch round (seat edit; head `58d0559`, seat rulings `6251864146`, os-dev-report `6252456713`)

- `origin/main` `32a171e565` (objectui#12965 / PR #12975) merged in as `174146b444`, no conflicts; `AiChatPage.tsx`'s `PendingDraftsBar` region is byte-for-byte `main`'s.
- `ChatPane` passes `onPreviewDraft`: the Live Canvas opens `draftPreviewPath(items, appSegment)`'s target under `?preview=draft` beside the conversation (the host stays on the conversation, as `onPreviewDraftApp` does and objectui#12724 rules). `LiveCanvas` takes an optional full `path` beside the app segment; the app-draft path is unchanged.
- `detectReplayOutcome` lifts a drafted replay's `drafted[]` into `ReplayOutcome.items` (shared `draftedItemsOf`), so the confirm-gated applied card, and the drafted badge an older cloud sends, draw Preview through the same door (`draftPreviewAction`: an app goes to `onPreviewDraftApp`, anything else to `onPreviewDraft`).
- `ChatbotEnhanced.tsx` carries the applied-card and badge Preview buttons (within the claim's original surface). Two exact-shape `mapMessages` pins gained the new `items` key.
- Ablation: dropping `onPreviewDraft` in `ChatPane` turns 4 pins red (the app-path control stays green); restore proven by blob hash `e81282cedec4`.
- Rulings 2 and 3 stand: no field-draft sentence on the bar (the applied card already says it), no record row.
